name: ThermaSol Fortis 3-4 Person Outdoor Sauna Cabin
description: Description Combining contemporary architecture with robust materials, the Fortis Sauna Cabin is a private, light-filled wellness sanctuary. The Fortis is highlighted by the modern, eave-style roofline offering a slight overhang which encapsulates the sauna interior. The Tyrol Wood exterior features unique natural textures accentuated by inset black trim, a stark contrast with the tinted glass front. Parsol argon insulated glass offers UV-protection on the front-facing facade, with hidden hinges and coat hooks providing sleek styling and utility. Inside, the Fortis hosts multi-layer wood fiber insulation to keep the interior cozy and energy efficient year-round. Tyrol wood walls offer a warm, textural contrast in comparison to the sleek thermo-aspen benches and backrests. Full-spectrum LED illumination from recessed locations compliments the inviting atmosphere, with an included control to perfect the desired ambiance. Bathing enthusiasts can sit back and enjoy the Harvia Virta's abundant heat and steam operated through the Harvia Xenio control for year-round sauna sessions. Supported by a 1-year warranty, the ThermaSol Fortis outdoor sauna delivers powerful performance and refined wellness in a modern, contemporary space. Features Pre-engineered cabin crafted from sustainably sourced materials blending beauty and practicality All-season weatherproofed performance with multi-layer wood fiber insulation, a Firestone EPDM roof, and integrated rainwater management Parsol argon insulated tempered glass with UV-protection for enhanced safety, thermal efficiency and privacy Harvia Virta electric sauna heater for powerful, evenly distributed heating performance Harvia Xenio sauna control touchpad to adjust time and temperature with repeat scheduling and WiFi connectivity through the MyHarvia App Full-spectrum recessed LED lighting with independent controls for a personalized ambiance Ideal for gardens, patios, and backyard wellness spaces Arrives fully assembled with pre-wired electrical for turnkey use Dimensions: 87"W (221 cm) x 90"D (228.6 cm) x 89"H (226.1 cm) Designed and crafted in the U.S.A. What's Included Pre-Assembled Sauna Cabin Harvia Virta 8kW Sauna Heater with Wi-Fi Harvia Xenio CX45 Digital Control with Wi-Fi Harvia AC3020 Sauna Stones (3) Temperature Sensor Headrest (2) Wood Platform MyHarvia App Installation Instructions Specifications Recommended capacity: 3-4 people Exterior (W × D × H): 87″ × 90″ × 89″ Heater: Harvia 8kW VIRTA Heater with Wi-Fi Sauna type: Traditional (Finnish) Installation: Outdoor, freestanding Lead time: Made to order, 12 weeks (plus 5–10 business days delivery) Shipping & Lead Time Freight is quoted separately for every order based on your delivery location and configuration. After you place your order, our team will contact you with your shipping quote before your build begins. Saunas are delivered fully assembled via flatbed trailer, and you'll be notified roughly two weeks before the scheduled delivery. A forklift or crane is required for placement, and a licensed electrician must connect the heater — manual offloading is not recommended. Documents Specification Sheet
